header.what: Resolution-ladder item manifest (ALBUM_ARTWORK_SEMANTIC_ORACLE_PIPELINE.md §7.4.3) plus the §7.3 transfer-check pairs
header.resolutionPolicy: NATIVE. Pipeline §7.5: the ladder runs every rendition at the size it is stored at — resolution IS the independent variable, so no cap and no normalization. Never upscaled (PHASE_0_DECISIONS.md §1).

rules: best rendition = largest MEASURED pixel area; ties prefer the un-suffixed original, then the lexicographically smallest path
no file with genuinely transparent pixels (research/v3/data/source-surveys/pixel_results.json)
NOT in research/v3/data/holdout/holdout.json, and not in that file's non-candidate quarantine list
eligibility.dimensionsFrom: image headers via sharp — never the _WxH filename suffix (§7.4.1 trap 1)

sharded.note: The sharded corpus has no holdout (PHASE_0_DECISIONS.md §5: fresh shards are effectively unlimited), so all 644 pairs are included.

sampling.rng: mulberry32 + Fisher-Yates, same generator the holdout freeze uses
sampling.universe: ladder-eligible artworks with >= 2 DISTINCT measured rendition sizes
sampling.forcedInclusion: every matched-contrast artwork (has a rung in 280-340 px AND one in 600-680 px) — the in-distribution anchor for the §7.3 transfer check

scopes.full: every rung of every ladder-eligible artwork
scopes.sample: every rung of the artworks with inSample = true
scopes.pairs: the 644 sharded cross-tier pairs (1,288 files), transfer check only
